text:
Aisha: Quick sync — CloudCo private-offer onboarding plus parallel co-announcement with Nimbus (HW) and EdgeWorks (SI). Need owners for: SSO + IAM, CMK/residency, SI integration checklist (networking, VPN, certs), and PR embargo window.

Bren: I can do SSO/IAM. Need CloudCo SAML metadata and Nimbus contact for HW image signing.

Kumar: I'll own CMK + manifests and HW-signed images. Note Nimbus requires signed image manifest with SHA256 and attestation. We'll include attestation in manifest as "signed_by": "nimbus-qa".

Dalia: PR/marketing: embargo note — press coordinated release on 2025-06-10 09:00 PT, partner quote required 48h prior. Also need approved one-line blurb for marketplace tile and co-marketing assets.

Aisha: Assign: Bren = SSO/IAM + publisher role, Kumar = CMK + signed manifest pipeline + security ticket, Dalia = PR embargo + partner comms. Partnerships will coordinate SI readiness with EdgeWorks: checklist includes VPN peering, service endpoint allowlist, and SSO mapping.

Bren: Sample IAM policy for staging role (minimal): ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow","Action": ["s3:PutObject","ec2:ImportImage","kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace/cloudco/*"}]
}
```

Kumar: Manifest example (index line): {"cloud":"aws","region":"eu-west-1","image":"ami-0f1a2b3c","sha256":"abcd1234ef...","signed_by":"nimbus-qa","kms":"arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:999:key/kkk"} We'll store at s3://marketplace-manifests/cloudco/1751234444-index.json. Filing SEC-9102 for external-KMS review.

Dalia: PR checklist: partner quotes, embargo date, approved hero screenshot, and co-branded explainer (1 pager). Ask Nimbus & EdgeWorks for logos and legal approval by EOD+2.

pub-bot: publisher-portal: CloudCo tenant created; webhook: https://publisher.redwood.ai/hooks/launch-1751234444; IdP upload pending.

Bren: I'll provision staging role and post the ARN by EOD. Also will request Nimbus image signing cert and workflow.

Kumar: CI jobs: build-aws-2001 (signed), build-gcp-2002, build-az-2003. Will push signed-manifest to index file and attach attestations. ETA 48h.

Dalia: Draft marketplace blurb: "CloudCo powered by Redwood Inference — enterprise-grade inference with regional key control and partner-certified hardware. Try the 14-day private trial." Feedback?

Aisha: Looks good. Next sync Friday 11am PT. Flag any blockers here. :rocket:
